title: Pocket2D actor template (*.template)
description: Actor template loaded by SceneFormat::LoadActorTemplateAsset (src/shared/scene_format/SceneFormat.cpp): one actor record with the same fields and component rules as a scene actor. Templates cannot inherit from templates, so template must be absent or empty. uid and parent_uid are parsed but replaced by the referencing scene actor. Duplicate member names are rejected in every object; unknown members are ignored and allowed here.

uid.description: Unsigned 64-bit actor UID, unique within the scene. 0 or absent means the loader assigns the lowest free UID.

parent_uid.description: UID of the parent actor; 0 or absent means no parent.

template.description: Must be absent or empty: template inheritance is not supported.

name.description: Actor name; overrides the template's name when nonempty.

propertyValue.description: A component property: a string, boolean or number scalar, a nonempty homogeneous array whose element type is fixed by its first element, or a typed array object (the only spelling of an empty array). Objects without __array_type, null and nested arrays are rejected.

intArray.description: First element is an integer, so every element must be a 32-bit integer.

doubleArray.description: First element is a non-integer number, so every element must be a number.

typedArray.description: Explicitly typed array, written by the editor for empty arrays. Other members are ignored.

component.description: One component. type names a native or Lua component type and may be omitted when it overrides a template component with the same key; the type "__editor_deleted__" removes the template component. Every other member is a property override.

components.description: Components keyed by a nonempty key that is unique within the actor. Keys are applied in sorted order.
